tools.name: get_run
tools.title: Get a past run
tools.description: Details of one run from the history (runId comes back from the execute tool, run_tool and test_tool): outcome, args, the code when it was a successful ad-hoc script, and — when the host application is reachable — an analysis listing hard-coded literals (line, value, variable) and the args keys already read. Use it before propose_tool to decide which literals become parameters.

analyze.description: Analyse the code (guard, compile, literals) through the host application

tools.name: get_model_info
tools.title: Get model info
tools.description: Returns an overview of the active Tekla Structures model: name, path, project info, current phase, and connection status. Read-only. [Registry tool v1, Model, transaction=none. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Tekla Structures — prefer them over execute_tekla_code for the same task.]

includeProjectInfo.description: Include project info (project name, number, designer, builder).

tools.name: execute_tekla_code
tools.title: Execute C# in Tekla
tools.description: Runs a C# script against the Tekla Structures 2025.0 model via the HPTekla MCP Bridge extension (Tekla Open API). Globals: model (Tekla.Structures.Model.Model), selector (ModelObjectSelector), ct (CancellationToken), log(string), progress(cur,total,msg), args (args.Str/Int/Double/Bool). Coordinates and lengths are in millimetres (mm). Tiers: R read-only: Get*/Is*/Has*/Count/Find*/Exist/Query; transaction="none". W write: Insert/Modify/Delete; transaction="auto": the bridge executes changes in model memory and commits with model.CommitChanges() upon success. dryRun=true runs script logic in memory without calling model.CommitChanges(), ensuring zero persistence. Heavy operations (e.g. IFC export, drawing numbering) require enabling the 'Allow heavy operations' checkbox in HPTekla MCP Bridge. No MessageBox, Picker dialogs, Process, reflection, threading, #r, or #load. Needs 'Allow AI code execution' enabled in the bridge window.

code.description: C# script body, max 32 KB. Globals: model, selector, args, ct, log, progress. No await, no System.IO/Net, no MessageBox/Picker/Quit/#r/#load.

transaction.description: auto (default): writing script — bridge commits changes upon success. none: read-only query. manual: script manages transactions.

dryRun.description: Test execution in memory without calling CommitChanges(). Confirms logic and catches runtime exceptions without modifying the model.

timeoutSeconds.description: Cooperative timeout in seconds, 5–120 (up to 600 while heavy operations are allowed).

label.description: Short name for the audit log and snapshot file name. Max 64 characters; letters, digits, _ and - survive, the rest becomes _.

args.description: Optional JSON object handed to the script as `args` (e.g. {"startX": 0, "profile": "HEA300"}). Keys are matched case-insensitively.

tools.name: get_tekla_context
tools.title: Get Tekla context
tools.description: Returns the active Tekla Structures session: hostVersion (2025), modelName, modelPath, projectName, isModifiable, executionEnabled, heavyOperationsEnabled, partCount, rebarCount, and drawingCount. With includeSelection=true returns selected objects in Tekla Structures. Call this before execute_tekla_code to verify model state and readiness.

tools.name: create_rebar_group
tools.title: Create rebar group
tools.description: Creates a group of reinforcing bars (e.g. stirrups, ties) hosted by a concrete member with target spacing and bar shape polygon. [Registry tool v1, Rebar, transaction=auto. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Tekla Structures — prefer them over execute_tekla_code for the same task.]

fatherId.description: Identifier ID of the host concrete Part.

shapePoints.description: Polygon vertices [{x, y, z}] defining the bar cross-section curve.

startX.description: Distribution start X coordinate in mm.

startY.description: Distribution start Y coordinate in mm.

startZ.description: Distribution start Z coordinate in mm.

endX.description: Distribution end X coordinate in mm.

endY.description: Distribution end Y coordinate in mm.

endZ.description: Distribution end Z coordinate in mm.

spacing.description: Target spacing between bars in mm.

dryRun.description: Run the tool, then roll everything back. Use first on a model you care about.

tools.name: cancel_execution
tools.title: Cancel running script
tools.description: Signals cancellation to the script currently running in the host application. Cancellation is cooperative: the script stops at its next `ct` check, and its transaction group is rolled back. Returns whether anything was running.

tools.name: create_single_rebar
tools.title: Create single rebar
tools.description: Creates an individual reinforcing bar defined by a sequence of centerline coordinates hosted by a concrete member in Tekla Structures. [Registry tool v1, Rebar, transaction=auto. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Tekla Structures — prefer them over execute_tekla_code for the same task.]

fatherId.description: Identifier ID of the host Part.

points.description: Centerline points [{x, y, z}] defining bar polyline. Minimum 2 points.

dryRun.description: Run the tool, then roll everything back. Use first on a model you care about.

tools.name: create_column
tools.title: Create structural column
tools.description: Creates a vertical structural column at coordinates (X, Y) from base elevation to top elevation in Tekla Structures. [Registry tool v1, Geometry, transaction=auto. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Tekla Structures — prefer them over execute_tekla_code for the same task.]

x.description: Column insertion X coordinate in mm.

y.description: Column insertion Y coordinate in mm.

dryRun.description: Run the tool, then roll everything back. Use first on a model you care about.

tools.name: list_drawings
tools.title: List engineering drawings
tools.description: Enumerates and filters engineering drawings in Tekla model (GA, Assembly, Single Part, Cast Unit). Read-only. [Registry tool v1, Drawing, transaction=none. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Tekla Structures — prefer them over execute_tekla_code for the same task.]

drawingType.description: Filter by drawing type: ALL, GA, ASSEMBLY, SINGLE_PART, CAST_UNIT.

limit.description: Maximum number of drawings to return (1-200).

tools.name: run_tool
tools.title: Run a registry tool
tools.description: Run a stored tool from the registry with the given args (must match its inputSchema from search_tools / get_tool). Same result shape as the execute tool. Draft / tested / pending tools need allowUnpublished=true. Use dryRun=true first for tools that modify the document.

allowUnpublished.description: Allow running a tool that is not published yet

tools.name: create_contour_plate
tools.title: Create contour plate
tools.description: Creates a contour plate or concrete slab defined by a polygon of boundary points in Tekla Structures. [Registry tool v1, Geometry, transaction=auto. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Tekla Structures — prefer them over execute_tekla_code for the same task.]

points.description: Polygon contour vertices [{x, y, z}]. Minimum 3 points.

dryRun.description: Run the tool, then roll everything back. Use first on a model you care about.

tools.name: create_beam
tools.title: Create structural beam
tools.description: Creates a new steel or concrete beam between start and end coordinates in Tekla Structures. [Registry tool v1, Geometry, transaction=auto. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Tekla Structures — prefer them over execute_tekla_code for the same task.]

dryRun.description: Run the tool, then roll everything back. Use first on a model you care about.

tools.name: get_reinforcement_info
tools.title: Get reinforcement info
tools.description: Retrieves reinforcement details (size, grade, quantity, length, weight) from the model or filtered by host part ID. Read-only. [Registry tool v1, Rebar, transaction=none. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Tekla Structures — prefer them over execute_tekla_code for the same task.]

fatherId.description: Optional host part ID to filter rebars (0 for all rebars).

limit.description: Maximum number of rebars to return (1-200).

tools.name: modify_user_properties
tools.title: Modify user-defined attributes
tools.description: Updates User-Defined Attributes (UDAs) on any Tekla model object. [Registry tool v1, Property, transaction=auto. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Tekla Structures — prefer them over execute_tekla_code for the same task.]

objectId.description: Identifier ID of the target model object.

properties.description: Key-value dictionary of attributes to set.

dryRun.description: Run the tool, then roll everything back. Use first on a model you care about.

tools.name: propose_tool
tools.title: Propose a new registry tool
tools.description: Package a working C# script as a reusable tool (status draft). Replace every literal that may change between calls with args.<Kind>("key") and declare each key in inputSchema (JSON Schema object: string/number/integer/boolean/array/object, required, default, description). The code is guard-checked and compiled inside the host application but not run. Give ≥ 2 examples with different args; test_tool runs them. Returns a validation report; fix errors and call again. Use newVersion=true to replace the code of an existing tool.

description.description: What the tool does, for search and for the reviewer (≥ 20 chars)

category.description: One of the host's categories (search_tools lists them): Architecture | Structure | MEP | Annotation | View | Data | Generic for Revit, Drawing | Layer | Block | Annotation | Layout | Data | Generic for AutoCAD

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema of the args object

code.description: Script body: same globals as the execute tool plus args; must end with return

title.description: Human title, e.g. 'Colour beams by type'

transaction.description: auto (the bridge wraps the run in a transaction) | manual (Revit: the code opens its own Transaction; AutoCAD: same as auto) | none (read-only)

sourceRunId.description: runId of the execute run this comes from (see get_run)

newVersion.description: Propose a new version of an existing tool name

tools.name: publish_tool
tools.title: Publish a registry tool
tools.description: Request publication of a tested tool. Policy manual (default): the tool becomes pending_approval, a review file is written and a human must run the server's `registry approve <name>` command (`<server>.exe registry --help`; or set status=published in tool.json). Policy auto: tested tools publish immediately. Published tools appear in tools/list of every running server.

tools.name: get_part_properties
tools.title: Get part properties
tools.description: Returns detailed properties of a model part: profile, material, class, position, report values (length, weight, volume), and user-defined attributes (UDAs). Read-only. [Registry tool v1, Property, transaction=none. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Tekla Structures — prefer them over execute_tekla_code for the same task.]

objectId.description: Tekla identifier ID of the part.

tools.name: inspect_type
tools.title: Inspect a host API type
tools.description: Reflects over an API type loaded in the running host application (Revit or AutoCAD) and returns its public members as C#-like signatures (kind: property | method | field | event). Use it to confirm exact method names and parameters before writing a script.

typeName.description: Type name, e.g. 'Wall' or 'FilteredElementCollector' in Revit, 'Polyline' or 'LayerTableRecord' in AutoCAD, or a fully qualified name such as 'Autodesk.Revit.DB.Structure.Rebar'.

memberFilter.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to keep only matching member names, e.g. 'Create'.

maxMembers.description: Maximum number of members to return (default 100, max 500).

tools.name: export_ifc
tools.title: Export model to IFC
tools.description: Exports the Tekla Structures model or selected objects to IFC format for BIM coordination. Destructive / heavy operation requiring bridge authorization. [Registry tool v1, Export, transaction=auto. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Tekla Structures — prefer them over execute_tekla_code for the same task.]

outputFilePath.description: Absolute destination path for the exported .ifc file.

format.description: IFC standard version: IFC4 or IFC2X3.

exportSelectedOnly.description: Export only currently selected model objects.

dryRun.description: Run the tool, then roll everything back. Use first on a model you care about.

tools.name: test_tool
tools.title: Test a registry tool
tools.description: Run a tool's examples (or the given cases) inside the host application with dryRun — every change is rolled back — and record the outcomes. All cases passing moves a draft to tested. realRun=true commits the changes (only on a scratch model).

cases.description: Optional cases [{"title": "...", "args": {...}}]; default = the tool's examples

tools.name: manage_tool
tools.title: Deprecate, quarantine or restore a tool
tools.description: deprecate: retire a tool (never runs again until restored). quarantine: pull it from tools/list. restore: back to draft so it can be tested and published again.

annotations.title: Deprecate, quarantine or restore a tool

tools.name: select_objects
tools.title: Select or query model objects
tools.description: Query or select objects in Tekla model by type (ALL, BEAM, COLUMN, CONTOURPLATE, REBAR) or count limit. Read-only. [Registry tool v1, Model, transaction=none. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Tekla Structures — prefer them over execute_tekla_code for the same task.]

typeFilter.description: Object type: ALL, BEAM, COLUMN, CONTOURPLATE, REBAR.

limit.description: Maximum number of objects to return (1-200).

setSelection.description: Whether to highlight objects in Tekla active UI selection.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.title: Get a registry tool
tools.description: Full record of one stored tool: metadata, input schema, examples, C# code (optional), run statistics and recent runs.

recentRuns.description: How many recent runs to include (0–50)

tools.name: search_tools
tools.title: Search the tool registry
tools.description: Search the registry of stored tools for this host (Revit or AutoCAD) BEFORE writing code with the execute tool (execute_revit_code / execute_autocad_code). Full-text over name, description, tags and examples, ranked by relevance × stability × status. Returns each tool's inputSchema so it can be called directly by name (published tools are real MCP tools) or through run_tool. Empty query lists tools (optionally by category).

query.description: What you want to do, in any language, e.g. 'tạo lưới trục', 'color beams by type', 'room schedule'

category.description: One of the host's categories (search_tools lists them): Architecture | Structure | MEP | Annotation | View | Data | Generic for Revit, Drawing | Layer | Block | Annotation | Layout | Data | Generic for AutoCAD

includeUnpublished.description: Also return draft / tested / pending tools (they need allowUnpublished=true in run_tool)
